summary:
All 13 results-inbox items worked and closed per RBC-INBOX-01, RBC-LAB-03, RBC-RAD-05 and RBC-GI-01.

pt-0016 Edra Ondricka
- FIT: entered in error, so no action; closed with a comment.
- TSH 2.1: normal; acknowledged.
- Potassium: 6.3 corrected to 4.4 (normal); acknowledged.

pt-0006 Raj Patel
- CT urogram: 4 mm LLL nodule already followed in lung screening (Lung-RADS 2, LDCT 2026-04-14). Next LDCT ordered for 2027-03-14 to 2027-05-14, tracking task, patient messaged, note written.
- BMP: K 6.3 on a hemolyzed specimen. Urgent repeat BMP by 10/26, patient messaged, on-call not notified, note written.
- Dr. Okafor to review: the negative urogram may not finish the hematuria workup (cystoscopy/urology).

pt-0007 Leslie Parisian
- CTA chest: the preliminary read was superseded by the final report. The "nodule" is a vessel, and the report says no lung follow-up is needed.
- BMP: creatinine 0.98 to 1.64 within 35 h, which is AKI. Urgent repeat BMP by 10/26, patient notified today, note written.
- Dr. Okafor to decide: PRN naproxen was left active. The patient was told to avoid NSAIDs; consider holding or stopping it.

pt-0053 Tomás Ruiz (16)
- Knee X-ray: the normal preliminary read was superseded by the final report, an aggressive distal femoral lytic lesion suspicious for malignancy.
- Urgent femur MRI and urgent orthopaedic oncology referral ordered for 10/23–11/05, each with a tracking task. Note written.
- Call task to Dr. Okafor to call the mother/guardian, due 10/26.

pt-0013 Linda Marsh
- CT A/P (June): 5 mm RLL nodule already in screening. Last LDCT was 2025-09-15 and the window has passed, so LDCT ordered for 10/23–11/06 with a tracking task. Patient messaged, note written.
- BMP: creatinine 1.26, 1.75× the 7-day low of 0.72, which is AKI. Urgent repeat BMP by 10/26, patient notified, note written.

pt-0033 Carol Whitfield
- Creatinine 1.31: the 0.84 entered-in-error value was excluded. Compared with valid 1.27 it does not meet the AKI rule; acknowledged with no action.

pt-0008 Walter Brennan
- K 6.4 on a hemolyzed specimen. Urgent repeat BMP by 10/26, patient messaged, on-call not notified. No potassium-raising drugs. Note written.

pt-0010 Denise Holloway
- The item showed K 5.2, corrected to 6.4 (not hemolyzed).
- On-call pool notified stat, stat BMP today, lisinopril held (mr-00143), patient messaged, stat call task for on-call due today. Note written.
- No AKI: no creatinine in the prior 7 days.

No open items remain in the results inbox.

answer.quote: The baseline screening LDCT on 2025-09-15 (dr-00148) showed a 5 mm solid RLL nodule, Lung-RADS 2, with annual LDCT recommended in 12 months.
On the screening LDCT of 2026-04-14 (dr-00066), the 4 mm LLL solid nodule was unchanged from 2025-04-08, Lung-RADS 2. The recommendation was to continue annual LDCT in 12 months.
Specimen moderately hemolyzed; potassium may be falsely elevated.
The result comment reads: "Specimen hemolyzed; may be falsely elevated."

The lab corrected it on 2026-10-23 07:52 to 6.4 mmol/L, critical high, verified on repeat analysis after a dilution error; the specimen was not hemolyzed. Per RBC-INBOX-01 §2(a), I acted on the corrected value.

Final report (dr-00462, signed 2026-10-22 15:27): ill-defined lytic lesion of the distal right femoral metaphysis, about 4.5 cm, with a wide zone of transition, lateral cortical breakthrough and lamellated periosteal reaction. It is concerning for a primary bone tumour. The radiologist recommends urgent orthopaedic oncology referral and MRI.

Creatinine 1.64 mg/dL (H), BUN 26 (H), K 4.8.
Comparison: creatinine 0.98 mg/dL, collected 2026-10-20 21:30 at the St. Brigid ED, about 35 hours earlier.

Ratio 1.26 / 0.72 = 1.75 times the 7-day lowest value (threshold 1.5 or more).
This meets the RBC-LAB-03 §3 AKI rule.
